chunks: That a man who had tortured his slave until he died was brought before ʿAlī عليه السلام. So he struck him one hundred lashes as a punishment, imprisoned him, charged him the value of the slave, and gave it in charity.

key_terms.تَصَدَّقَ بِهَا: It was given away in charity.
key_terms.قِيمَةَ الْعَبْدِ: The assessed monetary value of the slave.
key_terms.مِائَةً نَكَالًا: One hundred lashes as a deterrent punishment.

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on someone who tortures his slave until the slave dies?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal judgment of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام concerning a man who fatally abused his slave. The ruling combines corporal punishment, imprisonment, and financial liability, with the slave’s assessed value being given in charity.
